column7: The Kubernetes dynamic-secret engine dialled an admin-supplied api_server through a bare http.Transport and ignored allow_private_network_targets; core's host check resolves the name separately from the transport's own lookup, so DNS rebinding between the two reached private addresses. Fixed with a netutil dial-time guard on the explicit api_server (in-cluster address exempt). Found by the V7 egress-guard parity work, finding F1
